provenance.twin: twin v2: 100 ms step, per-RE RSRP (n78 100 MHz, 273 PRB), RS-SINR with 50% interferer load, Doppler-correlated fading (2-branch diversity), 3GPP RLF (Qout -8 dB / Qin -6 dB, N310=2, T310=1 s), HO failure on source-command loss or target SINR < Qout, 1 s re-establishment; CHO executions skip command loss
provenance.eval_seeds: 2300-2359 (pre-registered held-out; v3 training 0-399, sweep 500-509, federation 620-899, tuning 1000-1099, gate 1100-1102)
provenance.pairing: all arms run on identical radio traces per (cell, seed), one sim pass per trace
provenance.ci_method: 95% Student-t CI of the mean over episodes; paired-difference tests in working/evidence/finals-v3/report.md
provenance.baselines: oracle (knows the scenario x fading cell): a3_tuned, cho_tuned (sweep 500-504), cho_tuned_ext (extended grid, sweep 500-509); deployable (one network-wide setting): a3_global, cho_global, cho_global_ext, cho_mse (3GPP mobility-state scaling), cho_mro (MRO online offsets)
provenance.policy_arm: v3 v3.14.32 shown as policy although the verdict is NO-GO (v1.3.1 not in this run)
